question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**were given**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The given passage refers to an incident that happened in the past.**
 
• **Also, the subject of the sentence is plural "gifts" so we need a plural verb in the past tense.**
 
 
• "Have been given" and "have to given" are both incorrect because they use the present tense "have" instead of the past tense.
 
• Also, "Was given" is the past tense verb form for a singular subject, but the subject in this sentence is plural.
 
 
 
• "Were given" is the correct past tense verb form for a plural subject.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
